title: PBA: Terrafirma ends Govs Cup campaign by crushing Titan Ultra
summary: The Terrafirma Dyip concluded their PBA Season 50 Governors' Cup campaign on a high note, overpowering Titan Ultra 149-117 on Saturday at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.
